name: v2.4.2
body:
`v2.4.2` is a patch release scoped to fixing issues reported by users of Crossplane `v2.4` and fixing security related issues in Crossplane and its dependencies.

## 🎉 Highlights

* Fixed a bug where ownership of `ServiceAccount`s was not correctly transferred to newly active package revisions (#7838). Fixed in #7839 and backported in #7852.

## What's Changed
* [Backport release-2.4] fix: demote old revision controller ownerReference for SA by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/7852
* chore(deps): update module go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace to v1.45.0 [security] (release-2.4) by @crossplane-renovate[bot] in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/7847
* [Backport release-2.4] fix: fail closed when a claim cannot list its XRD by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/7862
* Bump crossplane-runtime dependency to v2.4.2 by @adamwg in https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/pull/7863


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/crossplane/crossplane/compare/v2.4.1...v2.4.2
